data.narrative:
Skild AI is a Series C AI & Software company founded by Deepak Pathak and Abhinav Gupta, valued at $14.0B post-money and having raised $1.4B+ to date. The applicable peer set comprises three same-stage, same-sector comparables: Figure AI ($39.0B), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B), and Together AI ($8.3B), alongside a broader universe of 8 private and 1 public comparable (Palantir).

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $14.0B last post-money valuation and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C progression, implies $23.8B. Peer-median analysis across the three direct comparables yields $10.0B, reflecting the wide dispersion in the comp set ($8.3B–$39.0B). The peer median is constrained by the inclusion of Together AI and Crusoe Energy; Figure AI's $39.0B valuation represents an outlier.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $8.5B (low) to $27.4B (high), with a median of $16.9B. The current $14.0B valuation sits near the lower bound of this range. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the peer set—particularly whether Figure AI's $39.0B reflects true market consensus or represents an outlier—and the appropriate magnitude of Series C step-up multiples in frontier AI subsectors, where volatility remains elevated.
